sentences.en: I've been feeling overwhelmed lately, mainly because the workload at my job has increased significantly without any additional support.
sentences.zh: 我最近一直感到不堪重負，主要是因為我工作的負擔大幅增加卻沒有任何額外的支援。

sentences.en: The joy I felt when I received the acceptance letter was unlike anything I had experienced before in my entire life.
sentences.zh: 當我收到錄取通知書時的喜悅是我一生中從未經歷過的。

sentences.en: Although I try to stay positive most of the time, there are days when anxiety gets the better of me and I struggle to focus.
sentences.zh: 雖然我大部分時間都試著保持正面，但有些日子焦慮佔了上風，我很難集中注意力。

sentences.en: What frustrates me the most about this situation is that I communicated my concerns clearly, yet nothing seems to have changed.
sentences.zh: 這個情況最讓我沮喪的是我已經清楚地表達了我的擔憂，但似乎什麼都沒有改變。

sentences.en: The sense of accomplishment that comes from finishing a challenging project is something that keeps me motivated through difficult times.
sentences.zh: 完成一個有挑戰性的專案所帶來的成就感，是讓我在困難時期保持動力的東西。

sentences.en: I'm not sure why, but I've been feeling nostalgic about my childhood lately, especially the summers I spent at my grandparents' house.
sentences.zh: 我不確定為什麼，但我最近一直對童年感到懷念，特別是我在祖父母家度過的那些夏天。

sentences.en: Being vulnerable enough to express your true feelings, especially in front of people you care about, takes tremendous courage.
sentences.zh: 足夠脆弱地表達你真實的感受，特別是在你在乎的人面前，需要極大的勇氣。

sentences.en: The disappointment I experienced after not getting the promotion taught me that setbacks are a natural part of professional growth.
sentences.zh: 沒有得到升遷後我經歷的失望教會了我，挫折是職業成長的自然一部分。

sentences.en: I find it difficult to articulate exactly how I'm feeling right now, because it's a complicated mix of relief and lingering sadness.
sentences.zh: 我發現很難確切地表達我現在的感受，因為這是一種解脫和揮之不去的悲傷的複雜混合。

sentences.en: Whenever I listen to that particular song, it brings back a flood of emotions that I thought I had already moved past.
sentences.zh: 每當我聽到那首特定的歌，它就會帶回一股我以為已經過去的情緒洪流。

sentences.en: The gratitude I feel toward my parents for their unconditional support is something I don't express nearly as often as I should.
sentences.zh: 我對父母無條件支持的感激之情，是我表達得遠不如應該的那麼頻繁的事。

sentences.en: I've come to realize that suppressing negative emotions, rather than processing them, only makes things worse in the long run.
sentences.zh: 我已經認識到壓抑負面情緒而不是處理它們，從長遠來看只會讓事情變得更糟。

sentences.en: The excitement I feel about starting this new chapter of my life is tempered slightly by the fear of the unknown that lies ahead.
sentences.zh: 我對開始人生新篇章的興奮，被前方未知事物的恐懼略微沖淡了。

sentences.en: What helped me through my darkest moments was knowing that I had friends who genuinely cared and were willing to listen without judgment.
sentences.zh: 幫助我度過最黑暗時刻的是知道我有真正關心我、願意不帶評判傾聽的朋友。

sentences.en: I feel incredibly proud of how far I've come, considering that just two years ago I was struggling with severe self-doubt.
sentences.zh: 考慮到兩年前我還在嚴重的自我懷疑中掙扎，我對自己走了多遠感到無比驕傲。

sentences.en: The loneliness that creeps in during the holiday season is something many people experience but rarely talk about openly.
sentences.zh: 在假期期間悄悄襲來的孤獨感是許多人都會經歷但很少公開談論的事。

sentences.en: I was so moved by her speech at the ceremony that I couldn't hold back my tears, even though I normally keep my emotions in check.
sentences.zh: 她在典禮上的演講讓我太感動了，我忍不住流淚，即使我平時都控制自己的情緒。

sentences.en: The anger I initially felt toward him has gradually transformed into understanding, now that I know the full story behind his actions.
sentences.zh: 我最初對他的憤怒已經逐漸轉變為理解，現在我知道了他行為背後的完整故事。

sentences.en: Sometimes I feel guilty about taking time for myself, even though I know intellectually that self-care is not selfish at all.
sentences.zh: 有時候我會對花時間在自己身上感到愧疚，即使我理性上知道照顧自己一點都不自私。

sentences.en: The relief that washed over me when I finally submitted my thesis was so intense that I actually started laughing out loud.
sentences.zh: 當我終於提交了論文時，那股湧上來的解脫感如此強烈，以至於我真的開始大笑起來。

sentences.en: I've noticed that my mood tends to improve dramatically when I spend time outdoors, particularly in places surrounded by trees and water.
sentences.zh: 我注意到當我在戶外度過時間時，我的心情往往會大幅改善，特別是在被樹木和水環繞的地方。

sentences.en: The embarrassment I felt after making that mistake in front of everyone was crushing, but it taught me to laugh at myself.
sentences.zh: 在所有人面前犯了那個錯誤後我感到的尷尬是令人崩潰的，但它教會了我自嘲。

sentences.en: What I find most healing about talking to a therapist is having a safe space where I can express myself without fear of being judged.
sentences.zh: 我覺得和心理治療師談話最療癒的是有一個安全的空間，我可以不怕被評判地表達自己。

sentences.en: The contentment I've found in my simple daily routine — morning coffee, a good book, an evening walk — surprises me more than anything.
sentences.zh: 我在簡單的日常作息中找到的滿足感——早晨的咖啡、一本好書、傍晚散步——比什麼都讓我驚訝。

sentences.en: I'm still processing the grief from losing my grandfather last month, and some days are significantly harder than others.
sentences.zh: 我仍在處理上個月失去祖父的悲傷，有些日子明顯比其他日子更難過。

sentences.en: The nervous anticipation I feel before every public speaking event never fully goes away, no matter how many times I've done it.
sentences.zh: 每次公開演講前我感到的緊張期待從未完全消失，不管我做過多少次。

sentences.en: I've learned that it's perfectly okay to feel multiple conflicting emotions at once, because human feelings are rarely simple or straightforward.
sentences.zh: 我已經學到同時感受到多種矛盾的情緒是完全沒問題的，因為人的感受很少是簡單或直接的。

sentences.en: The deep sense of belonging I experience when I'm with my closest friends is something I didn't have growing up and truly treasure now.
sentences.zh: 當我和最親密的朋友在一起時體驗到的深深歸屬感，是我成長過程中沒有的，現在真的很珍惜。

sentences.en: Expressing my frustration calmly and constructively, rather than bottling it up inside, has vastly improved my relationships with others.
sentences.zh: 冷靜且有建設性地表達我的挫折感，而不是壓在心裡，大幅改善了我與他人的關係。

sentences.en: I woke up this morning with an inexplicable feeling of optimism, as if something wonderful is about to happen, though I can't explain why.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上醒來有一種莫名的樂觀感，好像有什麼美好的事情即將發生，雖然我無法解釋為什麼。
